about_the_game:
A Kingdom on the Brink.

Your Choices Decide Everything.

Return to the world of Thronebreaker in this brand new DLC!
Take the role of a fallen king whose child was murdered and whose kingdom is on the edge of collapse.
Spies and traitors lurk in the shadows. Trust no one as you navigate a web of conspiracies and danger.
Every choice matters—will you rule with mercy, ruthlessness, or fall into despair?
Multiple endings, impactful decisions, and a dramatic journey await in this gripping 35-minute story expansion!

  • A brand new, choice-driven story

  • Shape your fate with your decisions

  • Can you save your legacy, or will darkness consume your kingdom?

content_descriptors.notes: Thronebreaker contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all players. The game features scenes of  , executions, and warfare. The story explores themes of betrayal, political intrigue, and the moral consequences of difficult choices. Some dialogue includes references to alcohol consumption and adult situations. While there is no explicit sexual content or depictions of non-consensual acts, the narrative may include implied romantic relationships, trauma, or sensitive topics such as loss and grief. Player discretion is advised.
